conservation.help_by: Give wildlife space; pick reef-safe sunscreen and careful finning.
conservation.caution_against: Don’t feed fish, chase animals, or pocket living souvenirs.

life_info.eating: Fish and squid hunted with teamwork and echolocation. Herding, mud-ring feeding, and clever local tricks.
life_info.mating: Calves stay with mothers for years learning dolphin school.
life_info.habitat: Bays, channels, and nearshore blue water in social groups. Pods chat with clicks and whistles — ocean gossip.

fun_facts: Each dolphin may have a unique whistle ‘name’ friends recognize.
They sleep with one eye open — half the brain naps at a time.
